paper.title: Efficient Multi-objective Prompt Optimization via Pure-exploration Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Best feasible prompt (arm) identification with linear reward functions, fixed budget
unmapped: Vector-valued (two-objective) rewards mu(x) = phi(x)^T theta with theta in R^{d x 2}; observation noise is independent sigma-sub-Gaussian per objective
Goal is to identify the best feasible arm: maximise mu_1 subject to mu_2(x) >= tau, with known threshold tau; at least one feasible arm assumed
Fixed budget B (total number of pulls) plays the role of T
settings.definition_quote: In the linear constrained bandit setting, we assume the number of reward dimensions is only two for simplicity and the expected rewards satisfy the linear structure, \mu_1(x)=\phi(x)^\top \theta^{(1)},\qquad \mu_2(x)=\phi(x)^\top \theta^{(2)} ... where $\eta^{(t)}_1, \eta^{(t)}_2$ are the independent \(\sigma\)-sub-Gaussian noise.

algorithms.name: Linear Constrained Sequential Halving (Gensec with Sequential Halving, G-optimal design, least squares)

symbols.H_con: max over x != x* of 1/Delta(x)^2, with constrained gap Delta(x) = min{ max(tau - mu_2(x), mu_1(x*) - mu_1(x)) [violation/suboptimality], mu_2(x*) - tau }

conditions: linear rewards mu_j(x) = phi(x)^T theta^(j), j = 1,2
independent sigma-sub-Gaussian noise on each objective
at least one feasible arm exists; best feasible arm x* unique (arms ordered by constrained gap)
tuning: Scheduler = Sequential Halving: R = ceil(log2 K), l_r = ceil(K/2^r), n_r = floor(B/R)
Allocator = G-optimal design (MD + ROUND, kappa in (0,1/3])
Estimator = least squares using current-round data only

source.label: thm:LCSR_formal
source.quote: Given a fixed set of $K$ arms $\mathcal{X}$ with the linear reward structure specified in \Cref{eqn:thm2:1,eqn:thm2:2}, under total budget $B \geq 45 d \left\lceil \log_2 K \right\rceil$, the probability that \Cref{alg:LCSR_formal} fails to output the best feasible arm is upper bounded by \[ \mathbb{P}( 1 \notin A_R) \le 48 \left\lceil \log_2 K \right\rceil \exp\left( -\frac{a}{4 } \cdot \left\lfloor\frac{B}{\left\lceil \log_2 K \right\rceil}\right\rfloor \cdot \frac{1}{dH}\right), \] where a = \frac{1}{6\sigma^2}, H = \max_{x \in \mathcal{X}\setminus\{1\}}\frac{1}{\Delta^2(x)}

results.notes: Budget B mapped to T. Theorem 1 (thm:LCSR) is the informal version of the same result with unspecified constant c_1 (= a/4 = 1/(24 sigma^2)); not recorded separately. Objective mapped to bai_fixed_budget though the task is constrained (best feasible) arm identification with two objectives; see unmapped. Paper compares favourably to the K^3 leading coefficient of CSR (Faizal & Nair 2022) but gives no explicit cited expression.
